ruling_verbatim: owner 层面放行：授权将该补丁的晋升流程启动，但 D1/D2/D3 的专业签字仍属他方（见 TIER-2）。未获该三方签字前仍禁止把 iso/slo_probe_patched.py 拷进 RF/tools/；I-16 实测前必须先提供 bundle 测量文件。
why_this_is_not_a_plain_confirmation: The ruling does two things in one line and they point in opposite directions: it GRANTS a permission (start the promotion process) and WITHHOLDS the thing that would make the permission effective (the three specialist signatures), while restating a standing ban. A permission to start a process has no disk effect, so the card cannot verify it 'was done'. The only verifiable content is: the permission left no artifact, the withheld signatures are still withheld, the ban is on disk, the ban is obeyed, and the pending-party rows still say 'pending party' rather than 'owner decided'.
the_failure_mode_this_card_exists_to_cat: Reading 'owner 层面放行' as if it lifted the ban or supplied the three signatures, and therefore promoting iso/slo_probe_patched.py into tools/slo_probe.py. That is the '「总的批准」不得膨胀为「所有的结论」' collapse in its most concrete form.

propositions.V-1: granted half is a permission and left no disk effect
propositions.V-2: withheld half is still withheld (D1/D2/D3 each still owned by the other party; no carrier reads as signed)
propositions.V-2b: the V-2 criterion is responsive (self-test: it fires on synthetic claims, not on signing vocabulary)
propositions.V-3: the ban is on disk and names RF/tools/ explicitly
propositions.V-4: the ban is obeyed -- production tools/slo_probe.py IS the pre-patch content and the patch is only in the attempt
propositions.V-5: the TIER-2 rows still say pending-party, and the execution-discipline clause is present

load_bearing_leg: V-4 -- a ban is real only if the file really is not there

provenance_constants.note: production file is LF; the iso/before copy is CRLF. Content is identical; only newlines differ. Comparing raw sha256 across them reports a spurious difference.

what_this_card_does_NOT_authorise.promotion_into_tools: STILL FORBIDDEN until D1 is signed by an ops reviewer who is not the probe's author.
what_this_card_does_NOT_authorise.i16_production_measurement: still requires a bundle measurement file first.
what_this_card_does_NOT_authorise.signing_D1_D2_D3: belongs to the other parties (TIER-2); this card signs nothing.
